html: The Mopan are a Maya people of the Petén lowlands of northern Guatemala and southern Belize. Their language is close to Itza and Yucatec Maya. At the time of the Spanish conquest they lived south-east of the Itza kingdom of Nojpetén, which held out until 1697, and Spanish campaigns then forced many into mission towns such as San Luis in Petén. In the 1880s Mopan families moved from Petén into southern British Honduras and founded San Antonio in the Toledo District. There they live beside Q'eqchi' villages, and in 2015 a regional court upheld the customary land rights of the Maya of Toledo.
